The `UserStats` component now computes three derived values using direct `const` assignments — matching the pattern from `page.tsx` (`const totalUsers = users.length`):

- `activeCount` — filters `users` by `isActive === true`
- `inactiveCount` — the remainder (`users.length - activeCount`)
- `activePercentage` — rounds to the nearest integer, guarding against division by zero when the list is empty
